primary_unknown_information_gate.predictive_model_comparison: all versus known_only and all versus measurement_matched_known are two separate preregistered predictive comparisons; both must pass. The per-query stronger-known oracle is descriptive only and has no p-value, LOFO result or PASS status.
primary_unknown_information_gate.common_face_unknown_estimand: the lower and upper unknown_involving_on_all_common_face bounds on full-universe, phenotype-blind fixed capacities and the common chemical optimal face; these are not called an exact plan-wise decomposition unless the face is unique
primary_unknown_information_gate.specificity_control: the primary unknown-involving common-face endpoint is tested by preregistered complete-response-profile permutations with chemistry, graph and fixed capacities unchanged. A formal p-value requires exchangeability blocks with a frozen nearest-neighbour diameter caliper; otherwise the permutation is sensitivity-only. Endpoint-by-world maxT is confined within each permutation family and family-level omnibus p-values use Holm, never a cross-family global maxT.
primary_unknown_information_gate.deterministic_reassignment_status: sensitivity stress only, not a calibrated null and not a claim gate
primary_unknown_information_gate.equal_capacity_control: measurement_matched_unresolved versus measurement_matched_known uses the same number of full-universe pairs and unavailable response values contribute zero rather than deleting a pair; a pairwise-common-availability sensitivity zeros both members whenever either response is unavailable
primary_unknown_information_gate.source_risk: for each preregistered comparator separately and every held-out source-axis, utility is correct minus two times wrong with abstention zero; all-minus-comparator utility is averaged over axes within source, sources within family and then families equally
primary_unknown_information_gate.source_inference: primary query sources and their provenance families must be globally disjoint from a score-blind frozen reference atlas; reciprocal source reuse is development-only. Conditional on that atlas, enumerate all 2^S query-source sign vectors when S is at most 20, or use a plus-one Monte Carlo sign-flip otherwise. Exhaustive enumeration is computationally exact, but inferential validity still requires independent query sources and paired-label exchangeability or source-delta sign symmetry. Participant bootstrap is restricted to within-source uncertainty.
primary_unknown_information_gate.primary_pass: intersection-union gate: both all-versus-known_only and all-versus-measurement_matched_known must independently have positive family-equal mean utility, one-sided p<=0.05, at least three quarters of exact-axis families positive, every other family non-harmful and every leave-one-family-out mean positive; all preregistered unknown-specificity gates must also pass
primary_unknown_information_gate.family_specific_claims: tested with Holm correction only after the primary gate; two or three sources in a family cannot support an individually significant family claim
primary_unknown_information_gate.coverage: all endpoints are unconditional on a fixed candidate universe; abstentions count as zero retrieval credit
primary_unknown_information_gate.minimum_generalization: at least four exact-axis families and eight independent held-out query sources, plus independently frozen reference sources supplying every exact target and mismatch, before a general method claim
